conflicts.permit: This information may also include location data and unique device identifier.
conflicts.prohibit: No information is collected to allow third parties identifying you as a person.
conflicts.situation: A third-party ad company in a free XAntGames app collects the user's unique device identifier to select relevant advertisements.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines device identifiers as personal information, yet says third parties collect nothing that lets them identify the user. It does not say whether unique device identifiers fall outside that definition.

conflicts.permit: For clarity, we do not knowingly sell the Personal Information of anyone under the age of 18 years old without affirmative authorization.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not knowingly collect, use, or share Personal Information from children under 18.
conflicts.situation: The Company knows that Personal Information belongs to a 17-year-old and has affirmative authorization to sell it to a third party.
conflicts.reason: The children section bars knowingly sharing any Personal Information from users under 18, while the next sentence implies sale is allowed with affirmative authorization. The policy gives no precedence between them.

conflicts.permit: we may collect information such as the websites you visit before or after you visit the Site or Application, pages you click-on on the Site or Application, IP address, location information
conflicts.prohibit: We will only access your location while you are using the Application or the Site and provided you have opted in to activate this feature.
conflicts.situation: A user who has not opted in to the location feature uses the Application, and automated data collection records location information.
conflicts.reason: Automated Data lists location information without any opt-in condition, while the Google Maps section says location is accessed only after opt-in. The policy does not say whether automated location is a different kind.

conflicts.permit: with our trusted services providers who work on our behalf, do not have an independent use of the information we disclose to them
conflicts.prohibit: Only aggregated, anonymized data is periodically transmitted to external services to help us improve the Application and our service.
conflicts.situation: The Application sends a user's unique device ID and IP address to a service provider that processes data on the developer's behalf.
conflicts.reason: One statement limits transmissions to external services to aggregated, anonymized data, while another permits disclosing Automatically Collected Information to service providers. The policy does not say whether service providers count as external services.
